subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Consensus Forecasting
description: A short lesson to help you apply Consensus Forecasting.

hook.text: Sales says 10,000 units. Marketing says 15,000. Finance says 8,000. The consensus meeting finds the truth.

buildup.text: Consensus forecasting combines inputs from multiple departments into a single agreed-upon demand number.

discovery.text: Each function brings unique insight: sales knows customers, marketing knows campaigns, finance knows budgets.

twist.text: Without structure, the loudest voice wins. Facilitation and data-driven processes prevent political hijacking.

climax.text: Structured consensus meetings improve forecast accuracy by 10–15% over single-source forecasts.

punchline.text: Many views, one number. That's the consensus power.

quiz.question: What risk does consensus forecasting face without structure?
options: The loudest voice dominates over data
